change: Use the stored POINT coordinate for its bounds, nearest-point results, logical snap and drag handle so a drag-handle round trip retains elevation.
validation: Pre-change focused test reproduced zeroed nearest-point Z, drag round-trip loss and failure to snap at the actual 3D point.
58 BuilderTest and EntityBuilderTest cases pass, including 3D nearest/bounds/drag/snap and a planar snapping control.
17 selection and canvas tests pass on macOS ARM64.
limitations: Snap-distance filtering now uses actual POINT elevation, as for other snap coordinates; native 2D viewer interaction with elevated source points requires separate qualification.
No claim is made for arbitrary 3D rendering, producer interoperability or other platforms.
